graph_interpretation.title: Multistation synchrony
graph_interpretation.key_message: High peak synchrony, but sparse or non-persistent.
graph_interpretation.reading: The synchrony CSV shows that up to 4 of 5 stations were simultaneously active. The maximum active fraction is 0.8 (80.0%), whereas the mean active fraction is 0.015873 (1.5873%). Synchronized samples represent 1.1661% of the analyzed window, with a maximum synchronized run of 1 sample(s). The temporal structure is classified as 'sparse synchronization episodes'.
graph_interpretation.caveat: The peak value is high, but the low sync fraction and short run length indicate transient synchronization rather than sustained network-wide coherence.
